summary: CD-0172 D1's last sentence limits the complete-step correction route it admits on break-fix and implementation workflows; it does not refuse the stale-law or stale Domain registry re-pin that ordinary stale recovery (CD-0041 D7) admits at the complete step of a workflow kind with no correction route, for example workflow.ops_runbook. That admission predates CD-0172 and stays unchanged. Amends CD-0172 D1 at that sentence only.
title: CD-0172 D1 limits only its correction route
